zadok1984.what: R. Zadok, The Elamite Onomasticon (AION Suppl. 40, 1984), archive.org OCR text. Element headwords + cited name spellings; OCR noisy (š often lost).

cdli.what: CDLI bulk ATF, texts whose catalogue language includes Elamite; {disz}/{m} and {d}/{dingir} words

kings.what: royal names only (Awan to Neo-Elamite), Akkadian governors and post-Achaemenid rulers dropped

_sources.manual: task brief list of famous elements/gods

primary_set_rule: test uses ALL names except period Achaemenid/RAE/N/LB/NA/SB (mostly non-Elamite or foreign-context); elements: all with >=2 vowels
